name: Ward
description: A basic protective ward every student learns in their first week.

name: Ember Bolt
description: A small dart of flame. The first offensive spell taught to mages.

name: Fire Wall
description: Raise a 3-tile wall of flame that burns anyone who enters or lingers. Usable in combat.

name: Mending
description: Knit small wounds and steady frayed nerves.

name: Rally
description: Steel yourself against fear — the discipline behind the Brace action.
